content.short: Call of Odin's Chosen is a play-to-earn pirate game running on Monad and TON.
content.description: Call of Odin's Chosen is a pirate-themed play-to-earn game deployed on Monad and TON, with a Bitcoin-style capped emission for its rewards. Capping rewards is a direct response to the earlier generation of play-to-earn games, whose economies collapsed under unlimited issuance.
content.meta: A pirate play-to-earn title on Monad and TON with a hard cap on reward emissions.
